text: Machine learning is a way for computers to learn from data instead of following strict, pre-written rules. One common type is called supervised learning. In this approach, you give the computer a set of training data, which includes examples with the correct answers. For instance, you might show it thousands of pictures of cats and dogs, each labeled correctly. Using this data, the computer builds a model, which is essentially a mathematical pattern that connects the input (like a picture) to the correct output. Once the model is ready, it can make predictions on new, unseen data, such as guessing whether a new photo shows a cat or a dog. Finally, you check the model's accuracy by seeing how often its predictions match the true answers on a separate test set, helping you know if the system is reliable.
